title: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Part 4

html:
Quest Giver: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Locate the Counterfeiters on Level 6 of the Shadow's Embrace. You inferred that Sir Ving N'Seacressy believes killing the Counterfeiting Foreman will break the distribution ring. Afterward, return to Sir Ving in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Part 5

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Locate the Counterfeiters on Level 6 of the Shadow's Embrace. You inferred that Sir Ving N'Seacressy believes killing the Counterfeiting Foreman will break the distribution ring. Afterward, return to Sir Ving in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

Remember Colorful Cal the Coin King? I heard a rumor that he is just a front man and that he confessed in hopes that his sentence will be reduced. He claims there's a coin pressing operation somewhere on Level 6 of the Shadow's Embrace--one which is always on the move, so it won't be there for long.

As coincidence has it *wink!*, I was in that same area recently, but carelessly left a mess before I departed. Would you do me a favor? Please find that area and clean things up for me before the wind blows everything away. You know what they say: Cleanliness is next to Goshliness!

Turn-in:

Great job cleaning up that garbage!

Have you heard? Word on the street is that the counterfeiters are Haxhaxors.

Objectives:

  • Take Out the Counterfeiter Foreman

Client level range: 49–100
